question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Steadily** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Steadily**" means something happening gradually and consistently over time. (समय के साथ कुछ धीरे-धीरे और लगातार घटित हो रहा है) • **For example**- *The company's profits have been steadily increasing over the past year.* • In the given sentence, "**steadily**" is an appropriate word choice because it indicates a consistent and unwavering effort or progress over time. • The author highlights that despite facing challenges or setbacks, they continued to work diligently without wavering from their goal. • Using "**steadily**" emphasizes their determination and persistence in their pursuit of finding out how to do something. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. **Complete paragraph:** *I went on (1) **steadily**__** **trying to 'find out how to'; but I wrote two or three novels without feeling that I had made (2) ______ progress. It was not until I wrote 'Ethan Frome' that I suddenly felt the artisan's full (3) ______ of his implements. When 'Ethan Frome' first appeared, I was (4) ______ criticised by the reviewers for what was considered the clumsy structure of the tale. I had pondered long on this structure, had felt its peculiar difficulties, and possible awkwardness, but could think of no (5) ______ which would serve as well in the given case: and though I am far from thinking 'Ethan Frome' is my best novel, and am bored and even exasperated when I am told that it is, I am still sure that its structure is not its weak point.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • "**Playfully**" means something done in a fun or lighthearted manner. (मज़ेदार या हल्के-फुल्के ढंग से किया गया कोई कार्य) • "**Ambiguously**" means something having multiple possible interpretations or meanings. (कुछ ऐसी चीज़ जिसकी कई संभावित व्याख्याएँ या अर्थ हों) • "**Plausibly**" means something seems reasonable or believable. (कोई बात उचित या विश्वसनीय लगती है) 43:Te42, The correct answer is: **much**
